data.name: Round Trip North Shore Haleiwa Shuttle
data.headline: All Ages • Departs Waikiki for Haleiwa at 8:00 AM • Returns to Waikiki at 3:30 PM • Up to 9 Pass.
data.description:
Experience the Best of Oahu's North Shore with Our Convenient Haleiwa Shuttle!

Escape the hustle and bustle of Waikiki and discover the laid-back charm of Haleiwa and the iconic North Shore with Wildlife Hawaii's round-trip shuttle service. Enjoy a fast, easy, and fun-filled day exploring Haleiwa Town, Waimea Valley, and Sunset Beach, all without the stress of driving!

Our Round-Trip North Shore Haleiwa Shuttle offers:

Convenient Waikiki Pickups: We offer multiple pickup locations in Waikiki, including Hilton Hawaiian Village, Gyu-Kaku Japanese BBQ, Sheraton Princess Kaiulani, and Waikiki Beach Marriott Resort & Spa. Hotel pick up is also available for an additional fee.
Direct Transportation: Relax and enjoy the scenic 60-minute ride to Haleiwa Town.
Flexible Stops: Explore Haleiwa Town, Haleiwa Boat Harbor, Waimea Valley (additional fee), and Ted's Bakery at Sunset Beach (additional fee).
Ample Free Time: Enjoy approximately 5 hours of free time to shop, dine, sightsee, or catch some waves.
Two Daily Shuttles: Choose from our morning or midday shuttle for your convenience.
Comfortable Share Ride: Enjoy a friendly and reliable shared transportation experience.
Round Trip Service: We provide comfortable and easy transportation back to Waikiki at the end of your adventure.

data.itinerary:
**North Shore Haleiwa Shuttle Itinerary**

**Option 1: First Shuttle (Morning Departure)**

* **7:20 AM - 7:35 AM:** Waikiki Pickup (Various Locations - see booking details)
    * Hilton Hawaiian Village Grand Islander Bus Depot (7:20 AM)
    * Gyu-Kaku Japanese BBQ on 307 Lewers St (7:25 AM)
    * Sheraton Princess Kaiulani (7:30 AM)
    * Waikiki Beach Marriott Resort & Spa (7:35 AM)
* **7:35 AM (Approx.):** Depart Waikiki for Haleiwa
* **8:40 AM (Approx.):** Arrive Haleiwa Town/North Shore Marketplace (Stop 1)
* **8:45 AM (Approx.):** Arrive Haleiwa Boat Harbor (Stop 2)
* **9:00 AM (Approx.):** Waimea Valley/Waimea Waterfalls (Optional Drop-off, additional fee)
* **9:15 AM (Approx.):** Ted’s bakery (Sunset Beach) (Optional Drop-off, additional fee)
* **9:30 AM (Approx.):** Omakase tour Turtle Bay Resort (Optional Drop-off)
* **9:00 AM - 2:00 PM:** Free Time in Haleiwa/North Shore (Explore shops, restaurants, beaches, etc.)
* **2:00 PM:** Depart Aloha General Store (North Shore Marketplace) for Waikiki.
* **3:30 PM (Approx.):** Arrive Waikiki.

**Option 2: Second Shuttle (Midday Departure)**

* **10:45 AM - 11:05 AM:** Waikiki Pickup (Various Locations - see booking details)
    * Hilton Hawaiian Village Grand Islander Bus Depot (10:45 AM)
    * Gyu-Kaku Japanese BBQ on 307 Lewers St (10:50 AM)
    * Sheraton Princess Kaiulani (11:00 AM)
    * Waikiki Beach Marriott Resort & Spa (11:05 AM)
* **11:05 AM (Approx.):** Depart Waikiki for Haleiwa.
* **12:00 PM (Approx.):** Arrive Haleiwa Town/North Shore Marketplace (Stop 1)
* **12:05 PM (Approx.):** Arrive Haleiwa Boat Harbor (Stop 2)
* **12:20 PM (Approx.):** Waimea Valley/Waterfalls (Optional Drop-off, additional fee)
* **12:20 PM (Approx.):** Ted’s bakery (Sunset Beach) (Optional Drop-off, additional fee)
* **12:00 PM - 5:00 PM:** Free Time in Haleiwa/North Shore (Explore shops, restaurants, beaches, etc.)
* **5:00 PM:** Depart Aloha General Store (North Shore Marketplace) for Waikiki.
* **6:30 PM (Approx.):** Arrive Waikiki.

**Free Time Suggestions (Haleiwa/North Shore):**

* Explore the shops and art galleries in Haleiwa Town.
* Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant or food truck.
* Visit Haleiwa Beach Park or other nearby beaches.
* Watch surfers at Waimea Bay or Sunset Beach.
* Browse the North Shore Marketplace.
* Visit the Haleiwa Boat Harbor.

**Important Notes:**

* Arrival and departure times are approximate and may vary depending on traffic and other factors.
* Please be at your designated pickup location on time.
* Optional drop-offs at Waimea Valley and Ted's Bakery require an additional fee.
* Hotel pickup is also available for an additional fee.
* Please confirm your pickup location when booking.

data.check_in_details:
**Check-In Details:**

* **Arrival Time:** Please arrive at your selected pickup location at least 10 minutes prior to the scheduled departure time. This allows for smooth boarding and on-time departure.
* **Pickup Locations:** Ensure you are at the exact pickup location you selected during your booking. Please refer to your booking confirmation for the location details and map links.
* **Shuttle Arrival Window:** The shuttle will arrive within the 20-minute window prior to the departure time. For example, if your departure is scheduled for 7:30 AM, the shuttle may arrive between 7:20 AM and 7:40 AM.
* **Identification:** Please have your booking confirmation (either digital or printed) readily available for verification upon boarding.
* **Hotel Pick-Up (If Applicable):** If you have arranged for hotel pick-up for an additional fee, please be waiting in your hotel's designated tour pick-up area or lobby at the scheduled time.
* **Contact Information:** In case of any delays or issues, please have the contact number for Wildlife Hawaii readily available.
* **Be Ready to Board:** Be prepared to board the shuttle promptly when it arrives.
* **Confirmation:** Please double check your confirmation email for any last minute changes.
